author: Ben Mendis
name: fujifilm_ratings
description: Reads the in-camera star ratings embedded in Fujifilm RAF raw files during import and applies them in darktable.
description-extensive: Fujifilm cameras let you rate photos with stars right on the camera, and this script brings those ratings into darktable automatically when you import your RAF raw files. That means you don't have to re-rate everything from scratch after importing. It requires the exiftool program to read the ratings from the files.
